title: Polymarket Launches Crypto Perpetual Futures With Up to 20x Leverage
message_html: Polymarket Launches Crypto Perpetual Futures With Up to 20x Leverage ...
snippet: The prediction market platform's new Perps product scaled from 10 markets to 67 on its first day—though the 20x leverage ceiling only applies to some of them, and none of it reaches U.S. traders.
